note: *Com a exultação de toda a terra é fundado o monte Sião*: the stylist asked the subject first, but then the appositions after the asterisk would be heard as the earth's. His order is an option.
*na cidade do Senhor dos poderes*: D43's formula again (23:10, 45:8). *dos exércitos*, the familiar wording from the Hebrew, is option 2; your call before it spreads.
The bare vocative *Deus*: the stylist found it abrupt and asked *ó Deus*. The rule gives *ó* only where the Latin has *O*; Ps 50 meets the same choice against the familiar text (HANDOFF 23).
